How it works
01

Choose your store

Pick from a small catalogue of ready-made online stores. Each one already stocked with digital goods — courses, templates, designer editions — that already sell.

02

Our team handles the marketing, the bilingual customer care and the day-to-day. Your store opens to traffic; you approve the direction.

Weekly payouts to the account of your choosing. No inventory, no logistics — digital goods deliver themselves.

Before you write

Earnings are settled every Friday to the account you nominate, in the currency of your choosing — EUR, USD or AED. A short statement accompanies each transfer.

Our atelier handles the marketing, the bilingual customer care and the operations. You approve the creative direction and receive monthly reports — never the inbox.

Each store is priced individually based on its catalogue and projected revenue. We discuss the right fit during your introduction call — there is no public price list.

Yes. Colour palette, name, copy and product mix can be tailored to your taste within a two-to-three-week window before opening.

A store can be re-listed at any time. We facilitate the introduction to a new owner and the transfer of operations, discreetly.
